question: What ritual elements constitute the first half belonging to the manifester?
premises: Purification and related acts are included
These acts form a complete set
This set is the first half of the manifester
inference: Purification and all related acts constitute the manifester's first half
uncertainties: The precise referent of vyañjakasya is context-dependent
plain_english: O goddess, purification and all such acts are the first half of the manifester.
